CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetKeyHash]() RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, CONVERT( varchar(32), SUBSTRING(HASHBYTES('SHA1', STRING_AGG(cast(FieldTypeID as nvarchar) + ':' + Value, char(59))), 3, 32), 2) as KeyHash from Asset A inner join Field F on F.ObjectType = A.Object and F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID and A.Object != 'ReferenceItem' inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID and FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 group by A.AssetTypeID, A.ID union select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, CONVERT( varchar(32), SUBSTRING(HASHBYTES('SHA1', STRING_AGG(A.code, char(59))), 3, 32), 2) as KeyHash from Asset A where A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem' group by A.AssetTypeID, A.ID
)
